product.description: CÂNTECUL SABIEI este al patrulea roman din seria de succes Ultimul regat scrisă de Bernard Cornwell, o cronică a istoriei Angliei de la începuturile sale, "la fel de captivantă ca Urzeala tronurilor, dar inspirată din evenimente reale" (The Observer), serie care a stat la baza unui excepțional serial de televiziune realizat de BBC. ESTE anul 885, iar în Anglia, divizată în regatul danez din nord și regatul Wessex din sud, domnește pacea. Războinic din instinct și viking din fire, Uhtred, fiul unui nobil din Northumbria, are pământ, soție și copii... și o datorie față de regele Alfred: să mențină granita pe Temes. Dar vikingii au invadat orașul Lundene, cu gândul să cucerească Wessexul.. cu ajutorul lui Uhtred. FORȚAT să aleagă între jurământul față de rege și valul periculos de schimbări ce se prefigurează, Uhtred trebuie să ia acum decizia care va determina viitorul Angliei.   BERNARD CORNWELL scrie un roman istoric şi de aventuri excepţional, un roman despre curaj, trădare, datorie, devotament, dragoste şi luptă, aşa cum se văd prin ochii unui războinic a cărui loialitate este împărţită între două lumi.   „Bernard Cornwell descrie scenele de bătălie mai bine decât orice alt autor pe care l-am citit vreodată, clasic sau contemporan.“ – George R.R. Martin

# The Last Kingdom: The Sword of Honour by Bernard Cornwell

Step back into the brutal and magnificent world of Anglo-Saxon England with *The Last Kingdom: The Sword of Honour*. This acclaimed novel is the fourth installment in the globally successful series penned by master storyteller Bernard Cornwell. If you are looking for historical fiction as captivating as *Game of Thrones*, but grounded deeply in real events, this epic saga awaits you.

***

## Chronicle of a Nation at War

*The Last Kingdom* offers an unparalleled journey into the tumultuous history of England from its formative beginnings. Set against a backdrop of constant conflict and shifting loyalties, Cornwell draws on historical accuracy while delivering riveting adventure.

The year is 885 AD. The island of England is deeply dividedâthe Danish kingdom rules the North, while Wessex holds tenuous authority in the South. Peace, though fragile, reigns over a land perpetually on the brink of war.

At the heart of this conflict is Uhtred, a warrior defined by his instinct and touched by Viking blood. Raised as a nobleman from Northumbria, he finds himself unexpectedly granted home, a wife, and childrenâbut also an unbreakable duty to King Alfred: defending the border along the Thames. Yet, the peace is shattered when Vikings invade the city of Lindene, setting the stage for Wessex to face its greatest threat yet.

## A Choice Between Worlds

Caught between his solemn oath to the king and the dangerous tide of political change sweeping across England, Uhtred must make a decision that will determine the fate of an entire civilization.

Bernard Cornwell crafts an exceptional historical adventureâa visceral novel exploring courage, devastating betrayal, unwavering duty, profound devotion, and brutal struggle. His writing plunges the reader directly into the chaos of battle and the intimate struggles of the human heart.

As acclaimed by George R.R. Martin, "Bernard Cornwell describes scenes of battle better than any other author I have ever read, classic or contemporary." Experience this breathtaking narrative through the eyes of a man whose loyalty is constantly torn between two warring worlds.
